blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scaling embodied simulation requires diverse objects with executable physical representations. We present RFW-W, a physical asset universe connecting rigid, articulated, and deformable asset sources to task-conditioned scene composition. Its reported inventories comprise 1,010,386 asset records: 524,611 rigid assets in 1,212 categories (RFW-R), 402,410 articulated assets in 531 categories (RFW-A), and 83,365 jointly verified deformables in 485 categories (RFW-S). These taxonomies contribute 2,228 dataset--category entries. RFW-R couples category-guided generation with collision geometry, composed physical properties, and interaction annotations; RFW-A uses reusable agent-authored procedural generators with explicit part and joint structure; RFW-S uses structure-aware simulation representations, calibration, and independent testing. A common interface preserves physical requirements specific to each asset type for retrieval and scene assembly. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that RFW-R provides broader asset coverage and stronger scene-fulfillment capabilities than existing datasets. Across five RoboTwin tasks, using 100 demonstrations per task for each asset source, policies trained on RFW-R achieve macro success rates of 71.2% in clean settings and 41.8% under randomization, exceeding the strongest baseline by 15.8 and 10.6 percentage points, respectively. RFW-W provides a scalable and unified asset foundation for generating physically grounded, task-conditioned embodied worlds.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to operate across diverse objects, layouts, and interactions. Physics simulation provides a scalable alternative to real-world data collection, enabling reusable and varied environments for embodied learning [ 52 , 25 , 77 , 108 , 114 , 107 ] . Yet its effective scope depends on the underlying asset library: scene generation and manipulation require not only diverse objects, but also representations that physics simulators can reliably execute.
blocks.zh: 通用内含的智能需要机器人在不同的物体,布局和相互作用之间运行. 物理模拟为现实世界的数据收集提供了可扩展的替代方法,使得能够对体现的学习进行可重复使用和不同的环境[52、25、77、108、114、107]。 然而,其有效范围取决于基础资产库:场景生成和操纵不仅需要不同的物体,还需要物理模拟器能够可靠执行的表示.

blocks.en: Large-scale 3D repositories and generative models provide millions of assets and open-category synthesis of geometry and appearance [ 9 , 24 , 23 , 59 , 134 , 117 , 116 , 56 , 95 ] . However, visual meshes alone do not specify metric scale, collision geometry, mass, friction, inertia, or interaction semantics. Collections such as YCB and Google Scanned Objects provide physical object models for manipulation and simulation [ 5 , 26 ] , but extending these representations across broad categories and hundreds of thousands of assets remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 大型3D寄存器和基因模型提供了数百万资产和几何和外观的开放类合成[9,24,23,59,134,117,116,56,95]. 然而,仅视觉介质并不能指定测量尺度,碰撞几何,质量,摩擦,惯性,或交互语义. YCB和Google扫描对象(Google Scanned Objects)等收藏为操纵和模拟提供了物理对象模型[5,26],但将这些表述扩展到广泛的类别和数十万资产仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Recent physical-asset datasets and articulation-modeling methods enrich 3D content with physical, functional, and articulation information [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 126 , 57 , 45 , 124 ] . ManiTwin adds manipulation-oriented digital twins, while Seed3D and EmbodiedGen connect assets to broader simulation-generation systems [ 101 , 40 , 107 ] . As shown in Table 1 , existing embodied asset libraries have limited asset scale and category coverage, incomplete part-level physical annotations, and limited support for dexterous manipulation. These limitations motivate the development of a large-scale physical asset universe that unifies diverse object types with executable physical representations for embodied simulation.
blocks.zh: 最近的物理资产数据集和表达模型方法以物理、功能和表达信息丰富了3D内容[6、7、8、126、57、45、124]。 ManiTwin增加了面向操纵的数码双胞胎,而Seed3D和EmbodyGen则将资产连接到更广泛的模拟生成系统[101,40,107]. 如表1所示,现有体现的资产库的资产规模和类别范围有限,部分层面的实物说明不完整,对狡猾操纵的支持有限。 这些限制促使形成一个大型的物理资产宇宙,将各种物体类型统一起来,并带有可执行的物理表示,用于体现的模拟.

blocks.en: We introduce RoboFlywheel-World (RFW-W) , a large-scale physical asset universe for embodied simulation, covering rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. RFW-W comprises three asset collections: RFW-R , containing 524,611 rigid assets across 1,212 categories; RFW-A , containing 402,410 articulated assets across 531 categories [ 71 ] ; and RFW-S , containing 83,365 jointly verified deformable assets across 485 categories [ 42 ] . Together, these collections comprise 1,010,386 asset records across 2,228 dataset–category entries.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Robo Flywheel-World(RFW-W),这是一个用于内含模拟的大规模物理资产宇宙,涵盖刚性、清晰和可变形的物体。 RFW-W包括三种资产收集:RFW-R,包含1 212类的524 611个硬性资产;RFW-A,包含531类的402 410个明细资产[71];RFW-S,包含485类的83 365个联合核实的变形资产[42]。 总共收集了2 228个数据集类目的1,010,386项资产记录。

blocks.en: RFW-W organizes these assets through type-specific construction pipelines. RFW-R, the focus of this work, combines category-guided generation with part segmentation, collision geometry, part-level physical properties, and simulation-validated grasp annotations across six dexterous hands. RFW-A employs agent-authored procedural generators to create articulated assets with explicit part and joint structures [ 71 ] , while RFW-S uses structure-aware simulation representations, calibration, and independent physical verification [ 42 ] . A common interface connects all three collections to task-conditioned asset retrieval and scene composition.
blocks.zh: RFW-W通过特定类型的建筑管道组织这些资产. 这项工作的重点RFW-R结合了分类制导生成与部分分解,碰撞几何,部分级物理性质,以及模拟验证的6个dexterous手的抓取说明. RFW-A使用代理授权的程序生成器来创建有明确部件和联合结构的明细资产[71],而RFW-S则使用结构感知模拟表示,校准,以及独立的实物核查[42]. 一个共同的界面将所有三个集合连接到有任务条件的资产检索和场景组成.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive evaluations to assess the coverage, physical fidelity, and downstream utility of RFW-R. Our evaluations cover asset and part-level coverage, physical annotation quality, cross-simulator consistency, dexterous grasp execution, scene construction, and policy learning. In scene construction, RFW-R fulfills all 265 object requests across 16 fixed scene foundations (Table 1 ). Furthermore, policies trained on RFW-R achieve the strongest macro success rates across five RoboTwin tasks under matched demonstration budgets (Table 5 ). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RFW-R in supporting physically grounded scene construction and downstream robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了广泛的评估,以评估RFW-R的涵盖范围、身体忠诚度和下游用途。 我们的评估涵盖资产和部分层面的涵盖范围、物理注释质量、跨模拟器的一致性、巧妙的把握执行、现场建设和政策学习。 在场景构造中,RFW-R完成16个固定场景地基的所有265个物体请求(表1). 此外,经过培训的RFW-R政策,在相应的示范预算下,五个RoboTwin任务取得了最强的宏观成功率(表5)。 这些结果表明RFW-R在支持实地现场建设和下游机器人操纵方面的有效性.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We present RFW-W , a large-scale physical asset universe comprising 1,010,386 asset records across rigid, articulated, and deformable objects, organized through a unified interface for task-conditioned asset retrieval and scene composition. • We develop RFW-R , a large-scale rigid asset collection featuring category-guided generation, part-level semantic and physical annotations, collision geometry, and simulation-validated grasp annotations across six dexterous hands. • We conduct comprehensive evaluations of RFW-R, covering asset and part-level coverage, physical annotation quality, cross-simulator consistency, dexterous grasp execution, scene fulfillment, and downstream policy learning across five RoboTwin tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D Asset Collections and Physical Asset Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 3D 资产收藏和实物资产数据集

blocks.en: Large-scale 3D repositories, including ShapeNet, 3D-FUTURE, ABO, OmniObject3D, Objaverse, Objaverse-XL, and Objaverse++, have substantially expanded the scale, category coverage, and visual diversity of available 3D assets [ 9 , 33 , 20 , 113 , 24 , 23 , 59 ] . Recent generative models, such as CLAY, TRELLIS, TRELLIS.2, Hunyuan3D 2.1, and etc., further enable open-category synthesis of high-quality geometry, textures, and PBR materials [ 134 , 117 , 116 , 95 , 56 , 128 , 14 , 13 ] . These resources primarily focus on visual appearance and geometric reconstruction, leaving the physical properties and interaction capabilities required for embodied simulation largely unaddressed.
blocks.zh: 大型3D寄存器,包括ShapeNet、3D-Future、ABO、Omni Object3D、Objaverse、Objaverse-XL和Objaverse++,大大扩大了现有3D资产的规模、类别覆盖范围和视觉多样性[9、33、20、113、24、23、59]。 近期的基因模型,如CLAY,TRELLIS,TRELLIS.2,Hunyuan3D 2.1等,进一步使高质量几何,纹理,以及PBR材料[134,117,116,95,56,128,14,13]的开放类合成成为可能. 这些资源主要侧重于视觉外观和几何重建,使体现模拟所需的物理特性和互动能力基本上得不到解决。

blocks.en: Early manipulation-oriented resources, such as YCB, provide physical object models for robotic manipulation [ 5 ] , while Google Scanned Objects provides scanned household assets for simulation. More recent physical asset datasets extend this direction by incorporating metric scale, material properties, physical attributes, affordances, and simulation-ready representations [ 6 , 7 , 126 , 57 ] . ManiTwin introduces large-scale manipulation-oriented digital assets with grasp annotations and verified interaction proposals [ 101 ] , while Seed3D and EmbodiedGen further connect physical asset generation to broader embodied simulation and world-generation systems [ 30 , 40 , 106 , 107 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期面向操纵的资源,如YCB,为机器人操纵提供了物理对象模型[5],而Google Scanned Objects则为模拟提供了扫描的家庭资产. 较近期的有形资产数据集通过纳入度量尺度、物质属性、物理属性、价格和模拟准备的表示[6、7、126、57]来扩展这一方向。 ManiTwin引入了大规模操控导向数字资产,并附有抓取说明和经核实的交互建议[101],而Seed3D和EmbodyGen则进一步将有形资产生成与更广泛的体现模拟和世界代系统[30,40,106,107]联系起来.

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 1 , existing physical asset libraries vary substantially in asset scale and category coverage. Moreover, detailed part-level physical properties and dexterous manipulation support are not consistently available across these datasets. RFW-W addresses these limitations by organizing rigid, articulated, and deformable assets within a unified framework for embodied simulation. It comprises RFW-R for large-scale rigid assets, RFW-A for agent-authored procedural generation of articulated objects [ 71 ] , and RFW-S for everyday deformable assets with configuration-specific physical and runtime verification [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,现有实物资产库在资产规模和类别涵盖范围方面差异很大。 此外,在这些数据集中,详细的部分层面的物理属性和直截了当的操纵支持并不一致。 RFW-W通过在体现模拟的统一框架内组织僵硬、清晰和可变形的资产来解决这些限制。 它包括大型硬性资产的RFW-R,代理授权程序生成的光刻物体[71]的RFW-A,以及日常可变形资产的RFW-S,具体配置物理和运行时间核查[42]。

blocks.en: 2.2 Physicalization and Interaction-Ready Asset Representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 实体化和相互作用 -- -- 备用资产代表

blocks.en: Semantic and part-level representations provide the structural foundation for physical asset construction. Shape-aware zero-shot semantic segmentation combines semantic recognition with spatial delineation using spectral cues from self-supervised pixel features [ 67 ] . PartNet establishes fine-grained hierarchical part annotations for 3D objects [ 76 ] , while SAPIEN provides a part-based interactive simulation environment for articulated objects [ 115 ] . GAPartNet further studies generalizable and actionable object parts across categories, connecting part perception to robotic manipulation [ 38 ] . These works establish the importance of identifying meaningful object parts beyond holistic geometric representations.
blocks.zh: 语义和半层表述为实物资产建设提供了结构基础. 形状-知觉零射的语义分解结合了语义识别和空间划分,使用自监控像素特征的光谱提示[67]. PartNet为3D对象建立精细的分级部分说明[76],而SAPIEN为被阐明对象提供部分基础的交互式模拟环境[115]. 大会 PartNet进一步研究跨类可通用和可操作的物体部件,将部分感知与机器人操纵联系起来[38]. 这些工作确定了在整体几何表达法之外确定有意义的物体部分的重要性。

blocks.en: Beyond semantic structure, physicalization requires assigning physical properties and constructing collision representations that can be executed by physics simulators. CoACD generates convex collision decompositions while accounting for geometric concavity [ 109 ] . PUGS combines shape-aware Gaussian reconstruction, vision-language property inference, feature-based propagation, and volume integration for zero-shot physical understanding and object-mass estimation [ 90 ] . Building on these directions, RFW-R assigns material and friction properties to semantic parts, estimates their physical attributes, and composes part-level mass, center of mass, and inertia into explicit rigid-body representations. It further constructs convex collision geometry and preserves the correspondence between visual geometry, collision geometry, and physical properties.
blocks.zh: 除语义结构外,物理化还需要分配物理性质,构建碰撞表达,这些表达可以由物理模拟器执行. CoACD 生成对流碰撞分解,同时计算几何收缩[109]. PUGS结合了形状感知的高斯重建,视觉语言属性推论,基于特征的传播,以及体积集成,用于零镜头物理理解和物体质量估计[90]. 基于这些方向,RFW-R将材料和摩擦特性分配到语义部分,估计其物理属性,并将部分质量,质量中心,惯性组成明显的刚体表示. 它进一步构建了凸轮碰撞几何,并维护了视觉几何,碰撞几何,物理属性之间的对应.

blocks.en: Interaction-ready assets additionally require annotations and executable grasp representations. ACRONYM and DexGraspNet provide large-scale simulated grasp datasets for general objects [ 27 , 105 ] , while GraspXL studies grasp motion generation for diverse objects [ 132 ] . ManiTwin and EmbodiedGen further connect physical asset annotations with manipulation-oriented interactions and embodied simulation [ 101 , 107 ] . However, grasp annotations or generated grasp proposals alone do not guarantee successful execution in simulation. RFW-R connects semantic part representations to dexterous grasp generation and validates candidate grasps through contact, penetration, closing, lifting, holding, and perturbation checks across six dexterous hand models. Its physical representations are also evaluated across multiple physics simulators to assess the consistency of their simulated behavior.
blocks.zh: 互动准备的资产还需要说明和可执行的把握。 ACRONYM和DexGraspNet为一般对象提供大规模模拟抓取数据集[27,105],而GraspXL研究则为不同的对象获取运动生成[132]. ManiTwin和EmformGen进一步将物理资产说明与面向操纵的相互作用连接起来,并包含模拟[101,107]. 然而,仅仅掌握说明或产生把握建议并不能保证模拟的成功执行。 RFW-R将语义部分的表示连接到巧妙的抓取生成中,并通过接触,穿透,关闭,提升,持有,和扰动检查验证候选人的抓取方式,跨越了六个巧妙的手型. 其物理表现也通过多个物理模拟器进行评估,以评估其模拟行为的一致性.

blocks.en: 2.3 From Physical Assets to Generative Embodied Worlds
blocks.zh: 2.3 从物质资产到基因创造世界

blocks.en: Procedural and language-driven scene generation has enabled increasingly diverse and scalable embodied environments through structured generation, asset retrieval, learned layouts, and physical constraints [ 25 , 86 , 87 , 31 , 125 , 34 , 123 , 60 ] . Related work has further explored interactive environments, scene understanding, controllable scene editing, and the reconstruction of simulation-ready scenes from real-world observations [ 52 , 32 , 18 , 120 , 98 ] . More recent agentic approaches incorporate multimodal reasoning, iterative planning, tool use, and visual or simulation feedback to construct task-conditioned, editable, and physically executable worlds [ 61 , 122 , 139 , 114 , 107 , 83 , 43 ] . In parallel, simulation platforms and data engines scale environments, tasks, and demonstrations for robot learning [ 93 , 82 , 53 , 54 , 41 , 94 , 77 , 17 , 73 , 102 , 108 ] . While these efforts primarily focus on generating, reconstructing, and scaling downstream scenes and interaction data, RFW-W focuses on the upstream physical asset foundation, organizing rigid, articulated, and deformable assets through a unified retrieval interface and connecting them to task-conditioned scene composition and downstream robotic learning.
blocks.zh: 程序和语言驱动的场景生成通过结构化生成、资产检索、学习的布局和物理限制[25、86、87、31、125、34、123、60],使环境变得日益多样化和可扩展。 相关工作进一步探索了互动环境,场景理解,可控场景编辑,以及从现实世界观测中重建模拟准备场景[52,32,18,120,98]. 较近期的代理方法包括多式联运推理、迭代规划、工具使用和视觉或模拟反馈,以构建符合任务条件、可编辑和可实际执行的世界[61、122、139、114、107、83、43]。 同时,模拟平台和数据引擎规模环境,任务,机器人学习示范[93,82,53,54,41,94,77,17,73,102,108]. 虽然这些努力主要侧重于生成,重建和放大下游场景和互动数据,但RFW-W侧重于上游的物理资产基础,通过统一的检索界面来组织僵硬,清晰,可变形的资产,并将其与符合任务条件的场景组成和下游机器人学习联系起来.

blocks.en: 2.4 Robot Policies and Training Data
blocks.zh: 2.4 机器人政策和培训数据

blocks.en: Diffusion Policy models visuomotor actions with a conditional diffusion process [ 19 ] , while RT-2 connects vision-language pretraining to robotic action prediction [ 4 ] . Open X-Embodiment aggregates demonstrations across robot platforms [ 80 ] , and Octo studies a generalist policy trained on this data and adapted to new settings [ 79 ] . These works motivate scalable policy learning from diverse experience. Our policy experiment examines a different input to that experience: the physical asset library used to collect task demonstrations. It holds the policy family and demonstration count fixed across libraries, while differences in category match, trajectories, and asset preparation remain part of the training-source comparison.
blocks.zh: 传播政策模型 visuomotor 动作带有有条件的传播过程[19],而RT-2将视觉语言预训与机器人动作预测[4]. Open X-Embodiment汇总了跨机器人平台的演示[80],Octo研究了一种对这些数据进行培训并适应新环境的通论政策[79]. 这些工作激励了从各种经验中学习可扩展的政策。 我们的政策实验研究了对这一经验的不同投入:用于收集任务演示的实物资产图书馆。 它将政策家庭和示范统计固定在图书馆之间,而类别匹配、轨迹和资产准备方面的差异仍然是培训-来源比较的一部分。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: RFW-W draws on rigid, articulated, and deformable asset sources for task-conditioned retrieval and scene construction (Figures 1 and 3 ). These sources retain distinct physical representations and verification records; a common interface exposes the fields required for a task while retaining the simulation models appropriate to each asset type.
blocks.zh: RFW-W利用刚性、清晰和可变形的资产来源进行任务规定的检索和现场建设(图1和图3)。 这些来源保留了不同的实物表示和核查记录;一个共同的界面暴露了一项任务所需的领域,同时保留了适合每种资产类型的模拟模型。

blocks.en: 3.1 Physical asset sources and construction procedures
blocks.zh: 3.1 有形资产来源和建造程序

blocks.en: RFW-R supplies 524,611 retained objects across 1,212 leaf categories. Category-conditioned generation and multi-view inspection establish coverage; semantic parts, convex collisions, composed physical properties, and interaction annotations make the assets usable for rigid-body simulation. Sections 3.2 and 3.3 describe this construction, and Section 4 evaluates its asset, grasp, scene, and policy outcomes.
blocks.zh: RFW-R供应524,611个保留物体,涉及1,212个叶类。 有条件的生成和多视图检查确立了覆盖范围;语义部件、对流碰撞、由物理特性构成、相互作用说明使资产可用于硬体模拟。 第3.2和3.3节描述了这一构建,第4节评价了其资产、把握、场景和政策成果。

blocks.en: RFW-A supplies 402,410 articulated assets across 531 categories [ 71 ] . Agents organize reusable components and their dependencies into category blueprints, implement executable generators, and repair failures across sampled configurations and joint states. Validated generators then sample new assets without per-asset model inference. Each sample retains its part hierarchy, joint parameters, visual and collision geometry, physical-property annotations, generator version, and seed. The companion study reports a 100% asset-level kinematic pass rate over its release and 99.5% passage of a one-second, root-fixed passive rollout in all four tested simulators on a 200-asset subset. These checks concern articulated structure and the stated passive regime; they are distinct from the RFW-R drop-response protocol. Articulation-estimation and real-object manipulation studies provide additional evidence for articulated assets.
blocks.zh: RFW-A为531个类别的402 410个明细资产提供[71]。 代理将可重复使用的组件及其依赖性组织到类别蓝图中,实施可执行的生成器,并跨样本配置和联合状态进行修复故障. 验证后的发电机然后在没有每资产模型推论的情况下对新资产进行抽样. 每个样本保留其部分等级,联合参数,视觉和碰撞几何,物理属性说明,生成版本,以及种子. 配套研究报告显示,资产级运动通过率在发布后达到100%,所有四个经测试的模拟器在200个资产子集上均通过一秒固定的被动推出,达到99.5%。 这些检查涉及所阐明的结构和所宣称的被动制度;它们与RFW-R滴答协议不同。 描述-估计和实体操纵研究为所阐明的资产提供了补充证据。

blocks.en: RFW-S contributes 83,365 jointly verified assets across 485 categories: soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, and bags [ 42 ] . Structure-aware adapters select compatible position-based dynamics (PBD) or material point method (MPM) representations and map inferred parameters to controls actually executed in Genesis 1.3.3. Calibration supports bounded corrections; a different physical probe tests the frozen candidate, and a separate check measures runtime behavior. The configuration-matched intersection retains 83,365 assets and all 485 categories. The resulting assets satisfy both physical-response and runtime criteria under the evaluated simulation configurations. Additional garment and grasping studies evaluate deformation behavior, manipulation performance, and object integrity.
blocks.zh: RFW-S提供了83,365项联合核实的资产,分为485个类别:软固体、布单、贝壳、服装和袋[42]。 结构感知适配器选择兼容的基于位置的动态(PBD)或物质点法(MPM)表示和映射推断参数,用于Genesis 1.3.3中实际执行的控制. 校准支持限定的校正;不同的物理探测器测试被冻结的候选者,以及单独的检查措施运行时间行为. 配置匹配的交叉路口保留了83,365个资产和全部485个类别. 由此产生的资产既符合实物反应标准,也符合评估模拟配置下的运行时间标准。 额外的服装和抓取研究评价变形行为,操纵性能,以及物体完整性.

blocks.en: RFW-W integrates rigid, articulated, and deformable assets through a unified interface for task-driven retrieval and scene construction. The interface organizes semantic, geometric, physical, and interaction information while incorporating type-specific representations, including collision geometry and grasp annotations for rigid objects, part hierarchies and joint parameters for articulated objects, and deformation models and simulation parameters for deformable objects. This unified organization enables efficient asset retrieval and scene composition based on task requirements and physical compatibility.
blocks.zh: RFW-W通过任务驱动检索和场景构造的统一接口,整合了刚性,伸缩性和可变形性的资产. 该接口组织语义、几何、物理和相互作用信息,同时纳入特定类型表示,包括刚性物体的碰撞几何和抓取说明、部分分级和拼接物体的联合参数,以及变形物体的变形模型和模拟参数。 这一统一的组织能够根据任务要求和物理兼容性,高效率地检索资产和现场组成。

blocks.en: 3.2 Category-guided Asset Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 类别指导资产产生

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents the RFW-R construction pipeline, spanning asset generation and quality control (L0–L2), physicalization and export (L3–L4), and downstream simulation evaluation (L5). In L0, we employ a human-curated taxonomy to guide large-scale asset generation. Qwen3.7-plus generates diverse category-conditioned object descriptions, which are converted into images using FLUX.2-klein [ 2 ] and a supplementary Wan2.7 generation path. RMBG-2.0 [ 3 ] extracts object foregrounds, and TRELLIS.2 [ 116 ] reconstructs textured 3D meshes.
blocks.zh: 图2显示RFW-R建筑管道,涵盖资产产生和质量控制(L0-L2)、实体化和出口(L3-L4)和下游模拟评价(L5)。 在L0中,我们使用人定型的分类法来指导大规模的资产生成. Quen3.7-plus生成不同的类别条件对象描述,这些描述会使用FLUX转换成图像. 2-klein [2]和一条补充的Wan2.7生成路径. RMBG-2.0 [3] 提取对象前景,TRELLIS.2 [116] 重建纹理3D meshes.

blocks.en: In L1, each generated asset is rendered from five viewpoints (front, back, left, right, and bottom). In L2, Qwen3.7-plus [ 121 , 84 ] evaluates the multi-view renderings for geometric completeness, object recognizability, rigid-body suitability, and category consistency. An agentic quality-control loop accepts qualified assets, rejects unsuitable candidates, or reassigns incorrectly classified objects followed by reinspection. This generation and filtering process yields 524,611 retained rigid assets across 1,212 categories. Additional implementation details and prompt specifications are provided in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 在L1中,每个生成的资产从五个角度(前、后、左、右和下)提供。 在L2中,Qwen3.7-plus [121,84]评价了多视图渲染的几何完整性,对象可识别性,刚性体的适宜性,以及类别一致性. 代理质量控制循环接受合格资产,拒绝不合适的候选人,或重新分配错误分类的对象,然后重新检查。 这一生成和过滤程序共产生524 611项固定资产,涉及1 212个类别。 附录A.2提供了其他实施细节和及时说明。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : RFW-R rigid-asset construction pipeline. Stages L0–L2 perform category-guided generation, multi-view rendering, and VLM-based quality control. Stages L3–L4 construct semantic part and collision representations, estimate physical attributes, and export the physicalized assets; L5 summarizes downstream simulation evaluations. The blue feedback loop supports category reassignment and reinspection, while the green feedback loop guides physical refinement. Assets exported after L4 support URDF, MJCF, and USD representations.
blocks.zh: 图2:RFW-R刚性资产建造管道。 阶段L0–L2执行类导生成,多视图渲染,以及基于VLM的质量控制. L3-L4阶段构建语义部分和碰撞表示,估计物理属性,并导出实体化资产;L5总结下游模拟评价. 蓝色反馈循环支持类别重排和复检,而绿色反馈循环则指导物理完善. 在L4支助乌拉圭发展基金、MCJCF和USD代理公司之后出口的资产。

blocks.en: 3.3 Physicalization and Interaction Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 物理化和相互作用说明

blocks.en: Following visual quality control, L3 constructs semantic part and collision representations. P3-SAM [ 72 ] identifies functional parts, while CoACD [ 109 ] decomposes object geometry into convex collision components for physics simulation. In L4, Qwen3.7-plus analyzes aligned RGB images and part masks to estimate part materials, friction coefficients, metric dimensions, and whole-object mass priors. Each part is assigned a mass m p = ρ p ​ V p m_{p}=\rho_{p}V_{p} based on its estimated material density and volume. Part-level properties are then composed into the object’s total mass, center of mass, and inertia tensor. When the ratio between the composed mass and the whole-object mass estimate falls outside [ 0.5 , 2 ] [0.5,2] , the part masses are uniformly rescaled while preserving their relative proportions.
blocks.zh: 根据视觉质量控制,L3构造语义部分和碰撞表示. P3-SAM [72]识别功能部件,而CoACD [109]则将对象几何分解为对流碰撞组件,用于物理模拟. 在L4中,Qune3.7-plus分析对齐的RGB图像和部分遮罩,以估计部分材料,摩擦系数,度量衡维度,以及整体对象质量前缀. 每个部分被分配质量 m p = ρ p 页:1 m_{p}=\rho_{p}v_{p}p}v_{p}p} 根据其估计的物质密度和体积. 然后将部分级属性组成物体的总质量、质量中心以及惯性抗拉器。 当构成的质量与整个物体的质量估计之比在[0.5,2][0.5,2]之外时,在保持其相对比例的同时,对部分质量进行统一调整.

blocks.en: After completing L4 physicalization, assets are exported to URDF and converted into MJCF and USD representations, preserving their geometric and physical properties across simulation formats. L5 denotes downstream simulation evaluations of the exported assets, with task-specific protocols and results reported in the experiments and appendices. These evaluations characterize asset behavior and provide feedback for physical refinement. Detailed physical annotation and composition procedures are described in Appendices A.2 and A.4 .
blocks.zh: 在完成L4的物理化后,资产被出口到URDF并转换成MCJCF和USD的表示,在模拟格式中保留其几何和物理特性. L5表示出口资产的下游模拟评价,具体任务的规程和结果在试验和附录中报告。 这些评价对资产行为进行了定性,并为实体改进提供了反馈。 附录A.2和A.4对详细实物说明和构成程序作了说明。

blocks.en: To further support robotic manipulation, we generate part-conditioned dexterous grasp annotations for six robotic hand models. Building on TRO-Grasp [ 29 ] , we condition grasp generation on target semantic parts through partial point clouds while retaining its hand-conditioned pose representation. Candidate grasps are filtered through semantic-part contact, mesh penetration, multi-finger engagement, and simulated closing, lifting, holding, and perturbation checks. The same annotation and filtering protocol is applied across the supported hands, producing executable grasp annotations associated with each asset’s semantic and physical representations. Additional details are provided in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步支持机器人操控,我们为6个机器人手型制作了部分有条件的dexterous caption说明. 在TRO-Grasp [29]的基础上,我们通过部分点云来限制目标语义部分的生成,同时保留其手持条件的姿势代表. 候选人的抓取通过语义部分的接触、网状穿透、多指接触和模拟关闭、提升、持有和扰动检查进行过滤。 同样的注解和过滤协议适用于被支持的双手,生成与每个资产的语义和物理表述相关的可执行的抓取说明。 详情见附录A.6。

blocks.en: 3.4 Task-driven Scene Construction
blocks.zh: 3.4 任务驱动的景区建设

blocks.en: Building on the constructed physical asset collections, RFW-W provides a unified interface for task-conditioned asset retrieval and scene generation. The interface organizes semantic, geometric, physical, and interaction information while preserving the representations required by rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Given a task description, a language model translates the requested objects and their spatial relationships into a structured scene specification. Assets are then retrieved from the corresponding collections based on semantic relevance and physical compatibility.
blocks.zh: 在已建成的实物资产库的基础上,RFW-W为任务性资产检索和场景生成提供了统一的接口. 界面组织语义,几何,物理,和交互信息,同时保留刚性,清晰,可变形的物体所需的表达. 鉴于任务描述,一种语言模型将请求的对象及其空间关系翻译为结构化的场景规格. 然后根据语义相关性和物理兼容性从相应的集合中检索资产。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , scene construction follows a task-core-first strategy. A geometric solver first assembles the task-relevant objects, including targets, supporting objects, and their required spatial relationships, in a room-independent coordinate frame. Once the task core is established, its object membership and relative poses are frozen. The surrounding room is then constructed using Infinigen [ 86 , 87 ] , which generates walls, floors, doors, and windows while respecting the frozen task core. Peripheral furniture, materials, and lighting are subsequently added under protected-region constraints, with procedural materials baked into PBR textures.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,现场建设遵循任务核心第一战略。 一个几何解析器首先将任务相关对象,包括目标,辅助对象,及其所需的空间关系,在一个室独立的坐标框架内组装. 一旦任务核心建立,其对象成员和相对面额就被冻结. 周围的房间然后使用Infinigen[86,87]建造,它产生墙壁,地板,门窗,同时尊重冷冻的任务核心. 周边家具、材料和照明随后在保护区的限制下增加,程序性材料烘烤成PBR纹理。

blocks.en: The generated scene undergoes functional and visual validation before export. Deterministic checks evaluate geometric consistency, task constraints, and semantic correctness, while a Qwen3.7-plus vision-language judge assesses visual realism and scene coherence. Failed checks trigger bounded refinement through separate functional and visual repair channels (R0–R5), without modifying the frozen task core. The final scene is exported as a structured description and self-contained USD package for Isaac Sim [ 78 ] . Figure 4 presents task-aligned examples across different indoor environments. The scene-fulfillment and downstream policy evaluations in this work are conducted using RFW-R assets.
blocks.zh: 生成的场景在导出前经过功能和视觉验证. 定型检查评价几何一致性,任务限制,以及语义正确性,而一名Qwen3.7-plus视觉语言法官则评估视觉现实性和场景一致性. 失败的检查触发了通过单独的功能和视觉修复通道(R0–R5)进行约束的改进,而没有修改冻结的任务核心. 最后的场景作为Isaac Sim的结构化描述和自成一体的USD包出口 [78]. 图4列出了不同室内环境中与任务相匹配的实例。 在这项工作中,利用RFW-R资产进行现场补充和下游政策评价。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Task-driven scene construction. Task instructions are compiled into structured specifications, followed by asset retrieval and task-core assembly. The frozen core guides room generation, appearance synthesis, and scene composition, while functional and visual checks support bounded refinement before export.
blocks.zh: 图3:任务驱动的场景建设. 任务指示汇编成结构化规格,然后是资产检索和任务核心组装。 冷冻的核心制导室生成,外观合成,场景组成,而功能和视觉检查则支持在导出前绑定精度.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Task-aligned scene examples. Ten task instructions paired with their corresponding scene renderings. Each example illustrates the requested action, target object, and support surface in the generated scene.
blocks.zh: 图4:与任务相匹配的场景实例。 10项任务指令与其相应的场景渲染配对. 每个例子都说明了请求的动作,目标对象,以及生成场景中的支持表面.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate RFW-R from asset construction to downstream use, examining semantic and physical annotation quality, cross-simulator behavior, dexterous grasp execution, robot policy learning, and task-driven scene construction. Cross-library comparisons use RFW-R as the rigid-asset source, while RFW-A and RFW-S are evaluated in their companion studies. The evaluation cohorts, metrics, and protocols are detailed in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价RFW-R从资产建设到下游使用,检查语义和物理注释质量,交叉模拟行为,解剖把握执行,机器人政策学习,以及任务驱动的场景构造. 跨图书馆比较使用RFW-R作为刚性资产源,而RFW-A和RFW-S则在配套研究中进行评估. 附录A.1详细列出了评价组、衡量标准和规程。

blocks.en: 4.1 Asset annotation and physical consistency
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 资产说明和实物一致性

blocks.en: We assess whether RFW-R provides reliable semantic annotations and physically consistent asset descriptions. Under the shared vision-language evaluation protocol, RFW-R achieves the highest category agreement (0.981) and functional agreement (0.860) among the compared libraries; its language agreement (0.864) is close to PhysX-3D (0.870), as shown in Table 2 . Metric definitions and object-level diagnostics are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们评估RFW-R是否提供了可靠的语义说明和物理上一致的资产描述. 根据共同愿景语言评价协议,RFW-R在比较图书馆中达成最高类别协议(0.981)和功能协议(0.860);其语言协议(0.864)接近PhysX-3D(0.870),见表2。 计量定义和对象级诊断载于附录A.3。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Part-level semantic annotation agreement evaluated with a shared vision-language judging protocol. Category, Language, and Functional denote the three annotation dimensions; higher scores indicate stronger agreement. Additional diagnostics are given in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 表2:用共同的视觉语言判断协议评价的部分语义注释协议。 类别、语言和功能表示三个注解方面;分数较高表示更一致。 附录A.3提供了其他诊断。

blocks.en: We examine physical-parameter consistency on 2,424 assets. The exported URDF and MJCF masses match the assigned object masses with a maximum relative error of × 10 − 6 1.5\!\times\!10^{-6} , and 98.5% of assets satisfy a relative tolerance of 10 − 3 10^{-3} between the sum of part masses and the stored object mass. Additional center-of-mass and inertia checks are reported in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们审查了2 424项资产实物参数的一致性。 输出的URDF和MCJCF质量匹配指定的对象质量,最大相对误差为×10−6 1.5\!\tims\!10×6}98.5%的资产满足部分质量与存储对象质量之和之间的相对容积为10−3 10×3}。 附录A.4中报告了额外的质量中心和惯性检查。

blocks.en: We further compare the native physical representations against solid-fill modeling on 31 retained assets. Replacing the native representation with solid fill decreases the mean drop-response criterion-pass fraction by 9.25, 9.25, and 7.53 percentage points in MuJoCo, Genesis, and Isaac Sim, respectively. The consistent decrease across engines highlights the importance of the mass distribution encoded by the native representations.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了当地实物表示与31个留存资产的固填模型。 用固体填充取代本土代表,在创世纪的MujoCo和Isaac Sim中,平均下降率标准通过分数分别减少9.25、9.25和7.53个百分点。 引擎之间的持续下降突出了由本地代表编码的批量分配的重要性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-simulator drop-response consistency
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨模拟器滴答一致性

blocks.en: To examine how the same physical assets behave across simulation engines, we conduct standardized drop-response tests on 2,257 common assets in PyBullet [ 21 ] , MuJoCo [ 96 ] , Genesis [ 36 ] , and Isaac Sim [ 78 ] . All engines use the same estimated physical properties and multi-hull collision geometry. Each asset is tested at three drop heights and five initial orientations. We calculate the fraction of trials satisfying the shared displacement, rotation, and penetration criteria, binarize it at 0.5 for agreement analysis, and use Pearson r r to compare the continuous fractions. The evaluation criteria are specified in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 为了检查同样的实物资产如何在模拟引擎中运行,我们对PyBullet[21],MujoCo[96],创世纪[36],和Isaac Sim[78]的2,257个共同资产进行了标准化的滴答测试. 所有发动机都使用相同的估计物理性质和多壳碰撞几何. 每个资产在三个下降高度和五个初始方向进行测试。 我们计算符合共享迁移、旋转和穿透标准的试验的分数, 将其二进制为0.5用于协议分析, 并使用皮尔逊 r来比较连续分数。 附录A.5规定了评价标准。

blocks.en: Across the four engines, 80.77% of assets receive the same thresholded label (Fleiss’ κ = 0.481 \kappa=0.481 ), counting both shared passes and shared failures. MuJoCo and Genesis show the highest pairwise agreement (94.20%, Cohen’s κ = 0.741 \kappa=0.741 ) and the strongest correlation in per-asset criterion-pass fractions ( r = 0.919 r=0.919 ; Table 3 ). These measurements quantify the consistency of RFW-R’s physical behavior across simulation backends.
blocks.zh: 在四台发动机上,80.77%的资产获得相同的门槛标签(Fleiss $ = 0.481\kappa = 0.481),既计算共享通行证,也计算共享故障。 MuJoCo和Genesis显示了最高的对偶协议(94.20%,Cohen's ob = 0.741\kappa=0.741)和每个资产标准-通过分数最强的关联性(r = 0.919 r=0.919;表3). 这些测量可以量化RFW-R在模拟后端的物理行为的一致性.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Cross-simulator drop-response agreement on 2,257 common assets. Agreement and Cohen’s κ \kappa are computed from criterion-pass fractions binarized at 0.5, whereas Pearson r r compares continuous fractions. All four engines agree on 80.77% of assets (Fleiss’ κ = 0.481 \kappa=0.481 ).
blocks.zh: 表3:关于2 257项共同资产的跨模拟器滴答协议。 Pearson r 比较连续分数。 所有四台发动机都同意80.77%的资产(Fleiss ' $=0.481\kappa=0.481).

blocks.en: 4.3 Dexterous grasp execution
blocks.zh: 4.3 Dexterous 抓取处决

blocks.en: We evaluate whether the part-conditioned grasp annotations can be executed by six dexterous hand models in Genesis. For each object–hand pair, up to 64 grasp candidates undergo closing, lifting, holding, and six-direction perturbation tests. A lift is successful when an object rises more than 0.075 m following a 0.15 m commanded motion. Robust success additionally requires successful holding and perturbation under three mass, friction, and pose settings. We report object-level any-success coverage: an object counts as successful if at least one evaluated candidate passes the corresponding test.
blocks.zh: 我们评价部分条件的抓取说明是否可以由创世纪的六个狡猾的手模型执行. 对每个物体的手对,最多64名抓获者将接受关闭、提升、举行和6次方向扰动测试。 当一个物体在0.15米命令运动后上升超过0.075米时,升降成功. 强劲的成功还需要在三个质量、摩擦和布局下成功保持和扰动。 我们报告对象级别的任何成功覆盖情况:一个对象如果至少有一名被评估的候选人通过相应的测试,就算为成功。

N L N_{L} and N R N_{R} are the numbers of evaluated objects for lift and robust success, respectively; the two metrics use different object cohorts. Macro denotes the unweighted mean across hands. Confidence intervals are reported in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 表4:六个手模型的模拟直截了当的把握结果。 NL N_{L}和NR N_{R}分别是评价对象的数目,以便升降和稳健成功;两个度量衡使用不同的对象群. 宏表示手掌之间未加权的平均值. 信任间隔见附录A.6。

blocks.en: With 64 candidates per object, the macro object-level coverage reaches 79.5% for lifting and 73.7% for robust grasping (Table 4 ). Ability and Inspire exceed 90% on both metrics, whereas Shadow reaches 42.3% lift coverage and 27.3% robust coverage. Figure 5 illustrates successful examples across the six hand morphologies. The variation between hands emphasizes the need for execution-based grasp assessment rather than relying on generated poses alone; candidate-budget and contact analyses appear in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 每个物体有64个候选者,大型物体的覆盖率达到79.5%的提升率和73.7%的强抓率(表4)。 两个指标都超过了90%,而Shadow达到42.3%的升降覆盖率和27.3%的强效覆盖率。 图5显示了六个手形态的成功例子。 人与人之间的差别突出表明,必须进行基于执行的把握评估,而不是仅仅依靠产生的因素;候选人的预算和联系分析载于附录A.6。

blocks.en: 4.4 Policy learning and real-robot trajectory replay
blocks.zh: 4.4 政策学习和实际机器人轨迹重现

blocks.en: We assess whether demonstrations collected with RFW-R assets improve downstream manipulation policies. We train separate π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 81 ] policies for each of four asset libraries across five RoboTwin [ 17 ] tasks, using 100 demonstrations per library–task pair and the checkpoint at training step 19,999. Each policy is tested on 100 clean and 100 randomized expert-solvable scenes, resulting in 4,000 closed-loop simulation rollouts. Randomization varies visual context, table height, and language instructions; full training and evaluation settings appear in Appendix A.7 .
blocks.zh: 我们评估使用RFW-R资产收集的示威是否改善了下游操纵政策。 我们为四个资产图书馆分别训练 0.5\pi 0.5}[81] 政策, 每个政策在100个清洁和100个随机的专家可溶场景上进行测试,结果有4000个闭路模拟推出. 随机化不同视觉上下文,表高,语言说明;完整的训练和评价设置见附录A.7.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Closed-loop RoboTwin policy success in simulation (%). Each asset library provides 100 training demonstrations per task; each task–condition cell is evaluated on 100 expert-solvable scenes. Clean and Randomized denote the two evaluation conditions, and Macro is the unweighted average across the five tasks.
blocks.zh: 表5:闭锁机器人Twin在模拟中的政策成功率(%)。 每个资产库每个任务提供100个培训演示;每个任务-条件单元在100个专家可解决场景上进行评估. 清洁和随机表示两个评价条件,Macro是五个任务的未加权平均值.

blocks.en: RFW-R-trained policies achieve the highest macro success rates in both clean (71.2%) and randomized (41.8%) evaluations, improving on the strongest baseline, ManiTwin, by 15.8 and 10.6 percentage points, respectively (Table 5 ). RFW-R leads on all five clean tasks and four of the five randomized tasks; PhysX-3D performs better on randomized Pillbottle-Pad (9% versus 6%). The matched demonstration budgets show the downstream value of the RFW-R training source under the evaluated task settings.
blocks.zh: 在清洁评价(71.2%)和随机评价(41.8%)中,经过RFW-R培训的政策取得了最高的宏观成功率,在最强基线(ManiTwin)上分别提高了15.8%和10.6%(表5)。 RFW-R领导所有5个清洁任务和5个随机任务中的4个;PhysX-3D在随机的Pillbottle-Pad上表现较好(9%对6%). 相应的示范预算显示,在评估的任务设置下,RFW-R培训来源的下游价值。

blocks.en: To evaluate the physical executability of simulation-generated motions, we run the learned policies in RoboTwin scenes populated with RFW-R assets and record the resulting action trajectories. Since the simulated and physical robots have different embodiments, we retarget the corresponding end-effector (EEF) trajectories to the real robot for open-loop execution, rather than directly transferring joint-space commands. Inspired by simulation-to-hardware trajectory replay in Wang et al. [100] and Kappel et al. [50] , we demonstrate real-robot execution across five task families. Figure 6 presents paired simulation and real-robot frames illustrating the grasp, lift, and place stages. Policy inference is performed entirely in simulation, while the physical robot executes the retargeted trajectories without online policy feedback. These qualitative demonstrations are separate from the closed-loop simulation success rates reported in Table 5 . Additional implementation details are provided in Appendix A.7.4 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估模拟产生的运动的物理可执行性,我们在 RoboTwin 场景中执行有RFW-R资产的知识政策,并记录由此产生的动作轨迹。 由于模拟和物理机器人有不同的化身,我们把相应的终端效应器(EEF)轨迹重新定位到真正的机器人上,用于开舱执行,而不是直接转移联合空间指令. 受模拟对硬件轨迹的启发,在Wang et al. [100]和卡佩尔等人著. [50],我们展示真正的机器人 执行五个任务家庭。 图6显示了组合模拟和真实机器人框架,说明抓住、升降和位置阶段。 政策推论完全在模拟中进行,而物理机器人在没有在线政策反馈的情况下执行重定向轨迹. 这些定性演示与表5中报告的闭路模拟成功率是分开的。 附录A.7.4提供了其他执行细节。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Cross-embodiment real-robot replay of simulation-generated trajectories. For five RoboTwin task families, the policy runs in simulation using RFW-R assets and its recorded trajectory is then executed on a physical robot. Sim and Real show the grasp, lift, and place stages in simulation and on hardware, respectively. The real-robot phase is trajectory replay, not closed-loop policy inference.
blocks.zh: 图6:模拟生成的轨迹的跨化真机器人重播. 对于五个RoboTwin任务家庭,政策是利用RFW-R资产模拟运行,然后在物理机器人上执行它记录的轨迹. Sim和Real在模拟和硬件上分别显示抓取,升降和放置阶段. 真机器人阶段是轨迹重放,而不是闭路政策推论.

blocks.en: 4.5 Scene construction and fulfillment
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 场景建造与实现

blocks.en: We evaluate the ability of RFW-R assets to satisfy task-driven scene specifications against EmbodiedGen v2 and ManiTwin. All three asset providers are tested on the same 16 fixed room foundations: one living room, two kitchens, seven offices, two bedrooms, three bathrooms, and one dining room. They share the requested objects, target sizes, support relations, and placement rules. In total, 265 requested instances form 153 groups, and unresolved requests remain in the fulfillment denominator. Shared camera target, azimuth, and distance candidates are used to select informative viewpoints. Five rendered views per provider–foundation pair yield 240 images across 48 conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价RFW-R资产对EmformGen v2和ManiTwin进行任务驱动场景规格检测的能力。 三个资产提供商都在同一16个固定房间地基上进行测试:一个客厅,两个厨房,七个办公室,两个卧室,三个浴室,以及一个餐厅. 它们共享请求的对象,目标大小,支持关系,以及放置规则. 总共265个请求实例组成153组,尚未解决的请求仍然处于落实标准。 共享的相机目标,方位角,以及距离候选人都用于选择信息化的观点. 5张是每个供应商的一对发现,

blocks.en: Table 6 : Task-driven scene fulfillment on 16 fixed room foundations. Inst. fill and Group fill report fulfilled requests out of 265 instances and 153 groups, respectively; Distinct is the number of unique assets used; Placement is the fraction of requested instances successfully placed.
blocks.zh: 表6:16个固定房间基座上由任务驱动的场景。 填充和组填充报告分别满足了265个和153个组的请求; 区分为使用的独特资产数量; 放置是成功放置请求实例的一小部分。

blocks.en: RFW-R fulfills all 265 requested instances and all 153 groups, compared with 258 instances and 149 groups for EmbodiedGen v2, and 240 instances and 135 groups for ManiTwin (Table 6 ). It also places every requested instance under the shared placement rules and uses 80 distinct assets, indicating stronger coverage of the fixed task requirements than the compared libraries.
blocks.zh: RFW-R满足了所有265个请求实例和所有153个组,而EmbodyGen v2为258个和149个组,ManiTwin为240个和135个组(表6)。 它还将每个请求的案例置于共同安置规则之下,并使用80种不同的资产,表明固定任务要求的覆盖面比比较图书馆要大。

blocks.en: For visual assessment, a Qwen3.7-plus vision-language judge scores each provider–foundation condition on realism, visual functionality, layout, completeness, prompt alignment, and style. Each condition is judged three times at temperature zero; scores are first averaged within the condition and then across the 16 room foundations. We estimate paired mean-score differences using 10,000 bootstrap resamples of the foundations.
blocks.zh: 在视觉评估方面,一个Qwen3.7+视觉语言法官给每个提供者评分 — — 建立在现实主义、视觉功能、布局、完整性、即时对齐和风格上。 每个条件以零温判断三次;分数先在条件内平均,然后跨16个室基. 我们用一万只靴子 重新标出地基 来估计成对的中分差异

blocks.en: Table 7 : Visual assessment of scene construction across 48 provider–foundation conditions (0–10 scale). Visual func. denotes visual functionality, Complete denotes completeness, and Prompt denotes prompt alignment. Each condition is scored three times; scores are averaged within conditions and then across 16 foundations.
blocks.zh: 表7:对48家供应商的现场建筑进行视觉评估(0至10级)。 Visual func.表示视觉功能,Complete表示完整性,Power表示即时对齐. 每个条件得分三次;得分在条件范围内平均,然后跨越16个基础.

blocks.en: RFW-R obtains the highest mean visual score (3.878), leading in layout, completeness, and style (Table 7 ). Its advantage over ManiTwin is 0.993 points (95% bootstrap interval [0.611, 1.444]). The difference relative to EmbodiedGen v2 is small (0.035 points; 95% interval [ − 0.108 -0.108 , 0.191]), indicating comparable overall visual ratings. Combined with the fulfillment results, these findings highlight RFW-R’s strength in supplying the requested objects and constructing task-aligned scenes.
blocks.zh: RFW-R获得最高的平均视觉分数(3.878),在布局,完整性和风格方面领先(表7). 它比马尼特温的优势是0.993分(95%的靴子间隔[0.611,1.444]). 与EmformGen v2的差别很小(0.035分;间隔95%[−0.108-0.108,0.191]),表明可比较的整体视觉收视率. 这些结果与实现结果相结合,突出了RFW-R在提供所要求的物品和构建任务相配合的场景方面的实力。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present RFW-W, a large-scale physical asset universe comprising over one million rigid, articulated, and deformable asset records across 2,228 dataset-specific category entries. By integrating category-guided asset generation, physical representations, and interaction annotations with task-driven scene construction, RFW-W provides a unified foundation for physically grounded embodied simulation. Extensive evaluations on RFW-R demonstrate broad asset coverage, reliable physical representations, and executable dexterous interactions. Furthermore, RFW-R achieves complete scene fulfillment in our evaluation and significantly improves downstream robotic manipulation performance over existing asset libraries. We believe RFW-W represents an important step toward scalable physical asset generation and the construction of diverse, interactive embodied worlds.
blocks.zh: 我们提出的RFW-W是一个大型的物理资产宇宙,由2 228个数据集特定类别条目的100多万个刚性、清晰和可变形的资产记录组成。 RFW-W通过将类别引导的资产生成,实物表现和互动说明与任务驱动的场景构造相结合,为物理上固化的模拟提供了统一的基础. 对RFW-R的广泛评价显示,资产范围广泛,实物表现可靠,而且可执行的、可执行的、非曲折的相互作用。 此外,RFW-R在我们的评价中实现了完整的场景,并大大改善了现有资产库的下游机器人操纵性能。 我们认为,RFW-W是朝着可扩展的有形资产创造和构建多元、互动的体现世界迈出的重要一步。

blocks.en: A.2.1 Generation and category reassignment

blocks.en: Image generation, background removal, mesh reconstruction, five-view inspection, and category reassignment produce the retained inventory. The visual rubric checks single-object content, rigid-body suitability, completeness, floating fragments, recognizability, and category agreement. Objects failing only category agreement are reassigned through lexical and image-conditioned matching, followed by reinspection for breakage and multi-object assemblies. Suitable unmatched objects form new size-bounded classes.
blocks.zh: 图像生成、背景清除、网状重建、五景检查和类别重新调配生成保留库存。 视觉标记检查单对象内容、刚性身体的合适性、完整性、漂浮碎片、可识别性和类别协议。 未能达成类别协议的物体通过逻辑和图像条件匹配进行重新分配,然后对断裂和多对象组件进行重新检查。 合适的未匹配对象构成新的大小限制类。

This separates semantic mismatch from unusable geometry: visually suitable objects can contribute to coverage after their labels are corrected, while 74,828 candidates remain outside the retained inventory.

blocks.en: A.2.2 Model and prompt specifications
blocks.zh: A.2.2 模型和即时规格

blocks.en: Qwen3.7-plus receives the domain and the English and Chinese category names and produces batches of English object descriptions in JSON. The prompt requests one sentence of 15–30 words per description, varying object sub-form, material and finish, style and era, color and pattern, condition and wear, and notable geometry. Twelve rotating diversity cues specify combinations of materials, styles, conditions, and colors. Generation uses temperature 0.9 and top- p p 0.95. Descriptions are deduplicated by token-set Jaccard similarity at 0.85 and screened for domain-specific material plausibility. FLUX.2-klein renders images from the selected descriptions with six inference steps and guidance scale 1.0; the supplementary Wan2.7 path samples descriptions across each category.
blocks.zh: Quen3.7-plus接收域名和英文及中文类别名称,并在JSON中产生批次的英文对象描述. 提示请求每个描述一个15~30字的句子,不同的对象子形式,材料和完成,风格和时代,颜色和图案,条件和磨损,以及显著的几何. 十二个旋转多样性提示指定了材料、样式、条件和颜色的组合。 世代使用温度0.9和顶部-p0.95. 描述通过0.85的符号集Jaccard相似性进行调试,并筛选出特定域的物质可信度. FLUX.2-Klein从选定的描述中制作图像,并附有六个推论步骤和1.0制导尺度;补充的Wan2.7路径样本描述涵盖每个类别。

blocks.en: Qwen3.7-plus [ 84 ] receives front, back, left, right, and bottom renders. Its ordered rubric asks whether the asset is a single object, a rigid body, complete, free of floating fragments, recognizable, and consistent with the requested domain and category. The response records these decisions and an object guess used for category reassignment. Ambiguous assignments are resolved from the rendered views and a candidate-category list, with an abstention choice. Follow-up prompts score visible breakage and the number of separate objects in a render.
blocks.zh: Qwen3.7-plus [84] 接收前,后,左,右和底部生成. 其订购的标点符号询问该资产是否是一个单一物体,一个刚性的身体,完整,没有漂浮的碎片,可以识别,并与请求的域和类别一致. 答复记录了这些决定和用于类别重新调配的对象猜测。 含糊不清的任务从提出的意见和候选人名单中解决,但弃权。 后续提示会分辨可见断裂和在渲染中分离物体的数量.

blocks.en: Qwen3.7-plus receives aligned textured RGB and color-coded part-mask views. The prompt uses the mask colors to locate parts and the RGB views to identify material category and subtype. For each part, it requests static and dynamic friction against rubber; for the complete rigid object, it requests metric dimensions and a mass estimate. The prompt asks for one answer per mask color and treats small or occluded parts in the context of the whole object. Material densities and part volumes then determine the composed mass, center of mass, and inertia in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: Quen3.7-plus接收到对齐的文本化RGB和彩色编码的部分任务视图. 提示使用遮罩颜色来定位部件和RGB视图来识别材料类别和子类型. 对于每一部分,它都要求对橡胶进行静态和动态摩擦;对于完全刚性物体,它要求测量尺寸和质量估计。 提示要求每个面具颜色一个答案,并在整个对象的上下文中处理小的或被占用的部分. 然后,材料密度和部分体积决定附录A.4中的构成质量、质量中心和惯性。

blocks.en: A.2.3 Physicalization pipeline
blocks.zh: A.2.3 实体化管道

blocks.en: Figure 2 connects three physicalization stages. L3 takes the accepted mesh and produces semantic part labels and convex collision components. These serve distinct roles: parts index material and interaction annotations, while collision components specify contact geometry. L4 takes aligned RGB views and part masks, estimates physical attributes, and composes mass, center of mass, and inertia in a common object frame (Appendix A.4 ). Assets are exported after completing L4, preserving geometry and physical quantities across simulation formats. L5 denotes downstream simulation evaluations of these exported assets. Evaluation outcomes provide diagnostic feedback for physical refinement. The cross-simulator evaluation uses the explicitly defined bounded-motion and penetration protocol in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 图2连接了三个物理化阶段. L3取了被接受的网状元件,产生语义部分标签和对流碰撞组件. 这些功能服务于不同的作用:零件索引材料和相互作用说明,而碰撞组件则指定接触几何. L4取对齐的RGB视图和部分遮罩,估计物理属性,并在一个共同的物体框架(Appendix A.4 )中组成质量,质量中心和惯性. 资产在完成L4后出口,保存几何和物理数量,采用模拟格式。 L5表示对这些出口资产的下游模拟评价。 评价结果提供诊断性反馈,供实体改进。 跨模拟器评价采用附录A.5中明确界定的限定运动和穿透协议.

blocks.en: A.2.4 Geometry cleanup
blocks.zh: A.2.4 几何清理

blocks.en: Conservative cleanup targets coincident vertices, fragmented components, and inconsistent part annotations while preserving openings and graspable structures. Category reassignment and geometric cleanup serve different purposes: the former recovers category coverage, while the latter improves the representation used for annotation and export. A paired audit of the construction stages finds that visual surfaces remain essentially unchanged after coordinate alignment; Appendix A.3.3 reports the measurements. Physical normalization aligns the physical properties and geometry in a common object frame while preserving the visual surface.
blocks.zh: 保守的清理目标为巧合的顶点,零碎的部件,以及不一致的部分说明,同时保留开口和可抓住的结构. 类别重新分配和几何清理服务于不同目的:前者恢复类别覆盖面,后者则改善用于注释和出口的表述。 对施工阶段的对等审计发现,在坐标对齐后,视觉表面基本上保持不变;附录A.3.3报告了测量结果。 物理正常化在保护视觉表面的同时,将物理属性和几何在共同的物体框中协调起来.

blocks.en: Figure S3 separates three diagnostic outcomes. Reassigning Coupon Box to Mug corrects semantic indexing. A remaining open boundary demonstrates that conservative cleanup preserves visual topology rather than guaranteeing a closed volume; volume-based measurements therefore require the eligibility check in Appendix A.3.3 . The hammer passes none of its 15 archived drop-response trials, identifying an asset that consistently violates at least one response criterion. This aggregate result identifies a failure under the downstream evaluation protocol; the violated criterion and its physical cause require trial-level diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 图S3将三种诊断结果分开。 将库邦盒重新分配给穆格纠正语义索引. 剩余的开放边界表明,保守的清理保存了视觉地形,而不是保证一个封闭的体积;因此,基于体积的测量需要附录A.3.3中的资格检查。 锤子没有通过15次存档的滴答试验,确定一个资产一贯违反至少一个答复标准。 这一总结果确定了下游评价协议下的失败;违反的标准及其实际原因要求进行试验一级的诊断。

blocks.en: Figure S3 : Observed diagnostic cases. A source category is reassigned from Coupon Box to Mug; a boundary remains open after processing; and a claw hammer fails the specified drop-response criterion in all 15 archived drop trials. The panels show three independent diagnostic examples.
blocks.zh: 图S3:观察诊断病例。 源类别从Coupon Box重新分配给Mug;处理后边界仍未打开;在存档的15次投放试验中,爪锤都未能达到规定的投放反应标准。 这些小组显示三个独立的诊断例子。

blocks.en: A.2.5 Recorded processing cost
blocks.zh: A.2.5 联合国 记录处理费用

blocks.en: Table S5 reports CPU time for physical normalization, repair, and collision reconstruction. Each stage is measured independently on the asset set listed in the table.
blocks.zh: 表S5报告了CPU进行物理正常化、修复和碰撞重建的时间。 每个阶段均在表中所列资产中独立计量。

Collision reconstruction has the largest mean CPU cost per recorded asset (1,000.5 s), identifying decomposition as a substantial cost within that measured cohort. These accumulated CPU hours describe compute consumption, not end-to-end wall-clock latency.

blocks.en: Appendix A.3 Geometry and Semantic Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录A.3 几何和语义评价

blocks.en: A.3.1 Geometry metrics
blocks.zh: A.3.1 几何测量

blocks.en: We characterize connected components, boundary-edge ratio, visual volume relative to convex-hull volume, and visual-to-collision surface distances. Deep intrusion measures collision samples lying more than 1 cm inside the visual volume and is evaluated on watertight meshes. The original diagnostic settings use a component threshold of 5,000, boundary ratio 0.30, solidity 0.20, visual-to-collision P95 distance 2 cm, and intrusion fraction 0.02.
blocks.zh: 我们描述连接的组件,边界-尖端比,相对于凸轮壳体积的视觉体积,以及视觉-对碰撞的表面距离. 深侵入测量在视觉体积1厘米以上的碰撞样本,在紧水层上进行评估。 最初的诊断设置使用的组件阈值为5000,边界比为0.30,固态为0.20,视觉对凝胶P95距离为2cm,入侵分数为0.02.

blocks.en: The baseline conversion for PhysX-3D and ManiTwin uses visual geometry for collision, so its visual-to-collision distance is a self-comparison. Geometry scores therefore depend on the collision representation as well as the source asset. Table S6 reports the diagnostic results for these source-specific collision representations.
blocks.zh: PhysX-3D和ManiTwin的基线转换使用视觉几何来进行碰撞,因此其视觉到缩合距离是自我比较的. 因此,几何分数取决于碰撞的表示和来源资产。 表S6报告了这些特定源的碰撞表现的诊断结果。

blocks.en: Table S6 : Original geometry diagnostic pass rates (%). Collision representations differ across sources as described in the text.
blocks.zh: 表S6:原始几何诊断通过率(%)。 如案文所述,不同来源的碰撞表述有所不同。

blocks.en: Hull solidity is the lowest individual RFW-R pass rate (81.6%), close to the joint geometry-only rate of 79.3%; the other individual gates pass at least 98.6%. Solidity is therefore the principal marginal bottleneck in this diagnostic. Low visual-volume-to-hull ratios can arise from concavities and openings as well as defective geometry, so this gate characterizes shape compactness under the chosen threshold. The 100% visual-to-collision distance rates for PhysX-3D and ManiTwin follow from using the same geometry on both sides of that comparison.
blocks.zh: 壳固度是单个RFW-R通过率最低的(81.6%),接近于79.3%的单联几何率;其他单个门至少通过98.6%. 因此,团结是这一诊断的主要边缘瓶颈。 视觉量对壳比率低,可能因孔径和开口以及有缺陷的几何而产生,因此这个门在所选阈值下具有形状紧凑的特点. PhysX-3D和ManiTwin100%的视向对折距离率,从比较的两边使用相同的几何学来遵循.

blocks.en: A.3.2 Semantic annotation metrics
blocks.zh: A.3.2 语义注释衡量标准

blocks.en: The four libraries share a Qwen3.7-plus vision-language scoring and aggregation protocol for category, language, functional, and physics-related agreement. CLIP [ 85 ] image–text similarity provides an additional alignment measure. The physics-related judge score measures semantic plausibility and agreement with the estimated physical annotations. Qwen3.7-plus also assists annotation generation, so this score describes model-based annotation consistency; physical-parameter accuracy requires independent measurements. N/A indicates that the released comparison sources do not provide a comparable physics-judge field under this protocol.
blocks.zh: 四个图书馆共用一个Quen3.7+视觉语言评分和汇总协议,用于类别、语言、功能和物理相关协议。 CLIP [85] 图像-文本相似性提供了额外的对齐措施. 与物理相关的法官得分衡量语义的可信度,并与估计的物理说明一致. Quen3.7-plus也协助了注释生成,因此这个分数描述了基于模型的注释一致性;物理参数精度需要独立的测量. N/A表示,根据该议定书,释放的比较源没有提供可比较的物理判断领域。

Table S7 : Part-level annotation quality under the shared judge.
All four libraries use the same scoring and aggregation protocol. ∗ EmbodiedGen v2 physics is computed on placeholder values; N/A denotes an unavailable comparable field.
blocks.zh:
表S7:共享法官之下的部分层次注释质量。
所有四个库都使用相同的评分和汇总协议. * EmformGen v2物理是按占位值计算的;N/A表示一个无法比较的字段。

blocks.en: RFW-R obtains the highest category (0.981) and functional (0.860) scores, while ManiTwin has the highest CLIP alignment (0.261 versus 0.244). The metrics answer different questions: the shared judge evaluates specified annotation dimensions, whereas CLIP evaluates image–text embedding alignment. Their different rankings indicate that broad visual–textual alignment and task-relevant annotation agreement should be interpreted separately.

blocks.en: The candidate budget controls how much of the generated grasp distribution is exposed to execution. Figure S9 shows the seven recorded budgets: coverage rises as the budget grows, with the largest gains for several hands occurring between 16 and 64 candidates. Table S11 gives the full-budget rates and the separate robust cohorts. Increasing the maximum from 16 to 64 permits four times as many candidate executions per object–hand pair, exposing the coverage–validation-cost tradeoff. These are object-level any-success rates after candidate search, so the candidate budget is part of the evaluation protocol. At the full budget, Ability and Inspire exceed 92% lift coverage, while Shadow reaches 42.3%, showing substantial hand-dependent variation under the shared asset and execution pipeline.

blocks.en: A.6.3 Robustness and closure displacement
blocks.zh: A.6.3 强力和关闭流离失所

blocks.en: Robustness is evaluated after the initial lift by combining holding with perturbations in mass, friction, and pose. Table S12 shows how many robust executions also satisfy the closure-translation bound, while Table S13 reports nominal, stronger, and combined perturbation outcomes on a separate stress-test cohort. Across the six hands, only five of the 10,432 robust successes fail the additional closure-translation bound. Closure displacement therefore removes few candidates that have already passed the robust test; this conditional count does not identify the causes of failed grasps. In the separate stress cohort, nominal-to-combined changes range from 1.0 to 5.9 percentage points, with the largest reduction for Allegro (86.3% to 80.4%). Ability and Inspire retain combined rates near 90%, while Shadow remains below 41% in all three settings. These outcomes distinguish baseline grasp coverage from sensitivity to the tested perturbations.
blocks.zh: 强力在初始升力后通过在质量,摩擦,和姿势上结合牵引与扰动来评价. 表S12显示有多少强力处决也满足了关闭-翻译的约束,而表S13则报告对一个单独的压力测试组群的象征性、强力和综合扰动结果。 在6个手掌上,10 432个有力成功中只有5个未能实现额外的封闭翻译约束。 因此,关闭流离失所使已经通过严格测试的候选人寥寥无几;这一有条件的计数无法查明掌握失败的原因。 在不同的压力组别中,名义上到综合上的变化从1.0到5.9个百分点不等,对Allegro来说减少幅度最大(86.3%到80.4%)。 能力与Inspire保留了近90%的综合率,而Shadow在所有三种情况下仍然低于41%. 这些结果区分了基线捕捉范围与对受试扰的敏感性。

blocks.en: Appendix A.7 Policy Data, Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录A.7 政策数据、培训和评价

blocks.en: A.7.1 Data budget and asset selection
blocks.zh: A.7.1 联合国 数据预算和资产选择

blocks.en: For each of the four asset libraries, we train a separate policy on each of the five RoboTwin tasks using 100 successful demonstrations per task. This yields 20 policies trained on a total of 2,000 demonstrations, with the same demonstration budget across libraries.
blocks.zh: 对于四个资产图书馆的每一个,我们对五个RoboTwin任务中的每一个任务分别进行政策培训,每个任务使用100个成功的演示. 这产生了20项政策,对总共2 000个示威活动进行了培训,各图书馆的示范预算相同。

blocks.en: Matching episode counts gives each source the same demonstration budget. The resulting comparison captures how the released asset coverage, trajectories, category match, and preparation choices combine to support policy learning. EmbodiedGen v2 uses one source asset per task, whereas the evaluation includes varied task objects, so the comparison measures the downstream utility of each released source under a fixed demonstration budget. Asset diversity and preparation remain components of this source-level comparison; attributing gains to an individual physicalization module requires a controlled ablation.
blocks.zh: 匹配的插曲计数给每个来源都提供了相同的演示预算. 由此得出的比较反映了所释放的资产覆盖范围、轨迹、类别匹配和准备选择如何结合起来以支持政策学习。 健壮 Gen v2每个任务使用一个源资产,而评价包括各种任务对象,因此比较根据固定的演示预算衡量每个释放源的下游用途. 资产多样性和准备仍然是这一源一级比较的组成部分;将收益归结到单个的物理化模块需要有控制的消减。

blocks.en: A.7.2 Training and evaluation settings
blocks.zh: A.7.2 培训和评价环境

blocks.en: Training. All four libraries use 100 demonstrations per task to fine-tune the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} base model with training seed 0 and global batch size 32. Evaluation uses the final checkpoint at step 19,999 for every source–task pair. Each source–task pair supplies its own training data and normalization statistics, and evaluation uses the final checkpoint without test-set selection.
blocks.zh: 培训。 所有四个图书馆都使用每个任务100个演示,以训练种子0和全球批量大小32来微调 0.5\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\基本模型。 校对:Soup 每个来源-任务组合提供自己的培训数据和正常化统计数据,评价使用最终检查站而不选择测试设置。

blocks.en: Closed-loop evaluation in simulation. Each of the 20 policies is evaluated on 100 clean and 100 randomized expert-solvable scenes, for 4,000 episodes. Clean and randomized suites are sampled independently. Randomization jointly varies visual context, table height, lighting, and instructions. Task success is the native RoboTwin success predicate; timeouts, planning failures, and infrastructure errors remain failures in each fixed denominator of 100. Each library has ten infrastructure-error episodes, all in the randomized condition.
blocks.zh: 模拟中闭路评价. 20个政策中,每个政策在100个清洁和100个随机的专家解决场景上进行评价,共4 000集。 清洁和随机化的套房是独立采样的. 随机化共同改变视觉上下文,表高,照明,以及指示. 任务成功是原生的RoboTwin成功前提;在100个固定分母中,超时、规划失败和基础设施错误仍然是失败。 每个图书馆有10个基础设施错误节目,都处于随机化状态。

blocks.en: The evaluation uses frozen suites. All libraries are evaluated using the same 100 seeds for each task–condition pair. The 100 evaluation episodes characterize each fixed trained checkpoint; training-seed variability is not estimated by this single-seed experiment.
blocks.zh: 评估使用冷冻套房。 所有库都使用每个任务条件配对的100个种子进行评估。 每个经过培训的固定检查站都有100次评价;这次单一种子试验没有估计培训种子的可变性。

blocks.en: A.7.3 Aggregation and task-level results
blocks.zh: A.7.3 汇总和任务一级的成果

blocks.en: Macro averages weight the five tasks equally. The strongest baseline is ManiTwin in both modes: 55.4% clean and 31.2% randomized, compared with 71.2% and 41.8% for RFW-R. RFW-R leads on all five clean tasks and four randomized tasks; on randomized Move Pillbottle Pad, PhysX-3D reaches 9% and RFW-R 6%.
blocks.zh: 宏平均值对五个任务的权重相等. 两种模式中最强的基准是马尼特温:55.4%清洁,31.2%随机,而RFW-R. RFW-R在所有5个清洁任务和4个随机任务上的领先率分别为71.2%和41.8%;在随机移动的Pillbottle Pad上,PhysX-3D达到9%,RFW-R达到6%.

blocks.en: The clean-to-randomized macro difference for RFW-R is 29.4 percentage points. Plate and Bowls-2 retain 76% and 73% success, compared with 96% and 98% in clean scenes. A2B-L and Stand reach 21% and 33%, and Pillbottle-Pad drops from 52% to 6%, the largest task-level difference (46 points). Randomized Pillbottle-Pad is difficult for every source (0–9%), identifying a shared task-level generalization gap. Because clean and randomized scenes are independently sampled and several factors change jointly, these differences summarize suite-level sensitivity; determining whether appearance, geometry, instructions, or planning dominates requires factor-wise evaluation or failure labels.
blocks.zh: RFW-R的清洁到随机宏观差异为29.4个百分点. Plate和Bowls-2保留了76%和73%的成功率,而在干净的场景中则是96%和98%. A2B-L和Stand达到21%和33%,Pillbottle-Pad从52%下降到6%,这是任务级别差异最大的(46分). 随机化的 Pillbottle-Pad 对每个源(0–9%)来说都是困难的,它确定了一个共享的任务级通用化差距. 由于清洁和随机的场景是独立取样的,有几个因素共同变化,这些差异概括了套房级别敏感性;确定外观,几何,指示,或规划是否主导需要因果评价或失败标签.

blocks.en: A.7.4 Cross-embodiment real-robot trajectory replay
blocks.zh: A.7.4 交叉表现真机器人轨迹重演

blocks.en: We run the learned policies in RoboTwin simulation with RFW-R assets and retarget the resulting EEF trajectories to a physical Piper robot for cross-embodiment replay. The simulated and physical robots have different embodiments; EEF alignment provides the task-space correspondence for executing the recorded motions on hardware. Policy inference is performed entirely in simulation, and the real robot executes the retargeted sequence without online policy feedback from real-world observations.
blocks.zh: 我们用RFW-R资产在RoboTwin模拟中运行了所学到的政策,并将由此产生的EEF轨迹重新瞄准一个物理的Piper机器人进行交叉化重放. 模拟机器人和物理机器人有不同的化身;EEF对齐提供了任务空间通信,用于在硬件上执行所记录的运动. 政策推论完全在模拟中进行,真正的机器人在没有从现实世界观测得到的在线政策反馈的情况下执行重定向序列.

blocks.en: Appendix A.8 Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录A.8 今后的工作

blocks.en:
Future work will focus on three directions. First, we aim to extend part-level affordance and grasp annotations to articulated object generation and reconstruction, building on recent advances in articulated reconstruction and generation [ 65 , 48 , 111 , 69 , 68 , 89 , 112 , 130 , 99 , 49 , 10 , 70 , 91 , 64 , 35 , 92 , 131 , 104 , 124 ] .
Second, we plan to extend agentic annotation and scene generation to 3D editing, automatic rigging, and dynamic 3D/4D world generation, enabling scalable code-to-video data synthesis for embodied AI and autonomous driving [ 110 , 14 , 133 , 63 , 15 , 12 , 119 , 44 , 55 , 88 , 1 , 47 , 118 , 58 , 66 , 11 , 127 , 103 , 135 , 138 , 137 ] .
Finally, we envision building a more comprehensive embodied benchmark and data engine by integrating diverse physical assets, interactive scenes, robot demonstrations, and multi-embodiment tasks [ 17 , 62 , 16 , 22 , 137 , 46 , 129 , 75 , 39 , 74 , 97 , 51 , 136 , 28 , 37 ] . This would enable systematic evaluation of manipulation capabilities, physical consistency, robustness, and sim-to-real generalization.
blocks.zh:
今后的工作将侧重于三个方向。 第一,我们的目标是扩大部分负担和理解说明的范围,以阐明物体的生成和重建,在阐明的重建和生成方面最近取得的进展为基础[65、48、111、69、68、89、112、130、99、49、10、70、91、64、35、92、131、104、124]。
其次,我们计划将代理注释和场景生成扩展到3D编辑、自动装配和动态3D/4D世界生成,为体现的AI和自主驱动提供可扩展代码到视频的数据合成[110、14、133、63、15、12、119、44、55、88、1、47、118、58、66、11、127、103、135、138、137]。
最后,我们设想通过整合各种有形资产、互动场景、机器人演示和多表现任务,建立一个更加全面的体现基准和数据引擎[17、62、16、22、137、46、129、75、39、74、97、51、136、28、37]。 这将有助于系统评价操纵能力、物理一致性、稳健性和模拟到实际的概括。
